# MarkZone Technology

> MarkZone Technology is a Dubai software company that creates, sells and supports business apps, websites and custom software for UAE SMEs. Serving all 7 emirates. Trusted by 400+ businesses since 2019. Arabic and English.

## Business apps

- [OxPOS](https://markzonetech.com/oxpos): Retail management for supermarkets, fashion and garment stores, cosmetics shops and consignment stores. POS, inventory, purchases, expenses, salaries, VAT reports, multi-branch. 1,500 AED including first-year maintenance, then 500 AED per year.
- [ZainaApp](https://markzonetech.com/zainaapp): Salon and spa management for ladies' salons, barbershops, spas and beauty lounges. Appointments, online booking page, WhatsApp booking notifications, staff commissions. 1,500 AED including first-year maintenance, then 500 AED per year.
- [TexPOS](https://markzonetech.com/texpos): Tailoring shop management for custom tailoring, ready-made items and alterations. Saved measurements including shaila and ghutra, job orders sent to the tailor on WhatsApp, deposits, fabric stock. Runs on the shop's own phone. 1,000 AED for the first year, then 500 AED per year.
- Coming Soon: MadaPOS (restaurants and cafes) and AqarOS (real estate agencies). See [Coming Soon](https://markzonetech.com/coming-soon).

- [OxPOS for supermarkets](https://markzonetech.com/oxpos/supermarkets), [garment and fashion stores](https://markzonetech.com/oxpos/garment-and-fashion-stores), [cosmetics shops](https://markzonetech.com/oxpos/cosmetics-shops) and [consignment stores](https://markzonetech.com/oxpos/consignment-stores).
- [ZainaApp for salons and barbershops](https://markzonetech.com/zainaapp/salons-and-barbershops).
- [MadaPOS](https://markzonetech.com/madapos): restaurant and cafe app, Coming Soon. No launch date or price announced.

OxPOS, ZainaApp and TexPOS are compatible with UAE VAT requirements.

Free trial: a free 1-hour trial of any app on a Zoom call.

## Services

- [Websites and web design](https://markzonetech.com/websites) (also for [Dubai, Sharjah and Ras Al Khaimah](https://markzonetech.com/websites/dubai-sharjah-ras-al-khaimah)): Delivered within 2 weeks. Starting from 1,500 AED; the final price depends on requirements.
- [Custom software and mobile apps](https://markzonetech.com/custom-software): Built around how the business works, fully delivered from about 2 months depending on size. Quote on request.

## Support

- Onboarding and setup (typically 45 minutes to 2 hours), data migration from Excel where available, and on-site visits when needed.
